summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (43 passed) under the prepared venv. Nothing is committed. Deviations: an explicit non-Node guard was added because Graph.value(None, ...) is a wildcard; this may trigger a mypy unreachable warning, which I could not check because mypy is not installed in the venv. Black and isort were not run; line lengths were checked and are within 88.
